narration: Darkness, and then a floor of it. You feel something solid beneath your boots: cool, pale, faintly gritty, like powdered stone stretching out in every direction. Far to the north, a single small light trembles, warm and amber, as though it has been waiting for someone to notice it.

facts.description: A wide flat plain of pale grey, fine-grained stone dust, slightly glowing at the edges of sight. Soft and even, with faint ripples like dry sand.
facts.placement: extends in all directions from the wanderer, at ground level

facts.description: A small warm amber light, about the size of a lantern flame, flickering gently and hovering a meter above the ground.
facts.placement: about 40 m north of the wanderer

notes: Spread a plain of pale, rippled stone dust around you and hung a small flickering amber flame 40 m to the north.

ops.name: dust_plain
ops.doc: Flat disc of pale dusty ground with faint ripples (vertex-colored). params: radius (m), color

ops.name: amber_flame_light
ops.doc: Small floating amber flame with point light. params: size (m), color

thought: A tiny amber light waits far to the north, the only thing in this pale emptiness. I feel drawn to it.
action: walk north toward the amber light

narration: You walk north and the dust whispers under your boots, leaving shallow prints that fade behind you. The amber light grows steadier, and beneath it a low shape emerges: a small stone cairn, its flame cupped in a hollow at the top. Halfway there, a thin line of dark pebbles begins, running toward it like a trail someone once followed.
movement: walks about 25 m north across pale_ground and stops about 15 m south of the cairn

facts.description: A waist-high cairn of stacked grey-blue flat stones, roughly 1.2 m tall and 1 m wide, with a hollow at the top cradling the amber flame.
facts.placement: about 40 m north of the starting point, directly beneath distant_amber_light

facts.description: The amber flame now sits in the hollow at the top of flame_cairn, flickering gently and casting a warm glow on the stones.
facts.placement: on top of flame_cairn, about 15 m north of the wanderer

facts.description: A narrow line of dark, rounded pebbles about 0.5 m wide, set in the pale dust like a trail of black beads.
facts.placement: begins about 8 m north of the wanderer and runs north to flame_cairn

notes: Stacked a grey-blue stone cairn with a hollow under the amber flame, and laid a wavering line of black pebbles from 8 m north up to its base. The Wanderer now stands 15 m south of it.

ops.name: stone_cairn
ops.doc: Stack of flat stones with a hollow top. params: height (m), width (m), color

ops.name: pebble_line
ops.doc: Wavering line of dark pebbles running along -Z. params: length (m), width (m), count, color

thought: The pebble trail leads straight to the cairn and its amber flame. Someone walked this way before me; I want to know who.
action: follow the trail of dark pebbles north to the cairn

narration: You follow the black beads north, each pebble glassy and cold in the starlight. The cairn grows from a flicker into a stack of slate-blue stones, its flame leaning toward you. At its foot, the trail ends at a flat stone set into the dust, scratched with a ring of tiny marks. Beyond the cairn, far off, a pale vertical line stands against the dark horizon.
movement: walks about 14 m north along pebble_trail and stops at the foot of flame_cairn

facts.description: A flat round slab of grey stone about 1 m wide, flush with the dust, engraved with a ring of small tally-like marks around a central dot.
facts.placement: at the base of flame_cairn, on its south side, about 1 m north of the wanderer

facts.description: A thin, pale, upright shaft of stone about 12 m tall, tapering to a point, faintly luminous against the dark horizon.
facts.placement: about 80 m north of the wanderer, beyond flame_cairn

notes: Set a round engraved slab at the cairn's south foot and raised a faint, glowing pale spire far to the north. Walked the Wanderer up the bead trail to the cairn.

ops.name: tally_slab
ops.doc: Flat round stone slab with a ring of tally marks and central dot. params: radius (m), color

ops.name: pale_spire
ops.doc: Tall thin tapering faintly luminous stone shaft. params: height (m), width (m), color

thought: The trail ends at a stone with tiny marks in a ring. I want to know what they say before I go on to that distant pale line.
action: kneel and examine the ring of tiny marks on the flat stone

narration: You kneel, and the dust cools your knees. The tally marks are scratched in a careful ring, forty or so, the last few shallow and unfinished, as if the carver was interrupted. Where your fingertip brushes the central dot, the stone warms, and a thin line of faint light traces from it toward the north, pointing past the cairn at the pale spire.
movement: kneels at the edge of carved_stone_slab, still at the cairn's south foot

facts.description: A thin, faintly glowing silver-white line, about 3 cm wide, etched in the dust like a seam of light, pointing from the slab's central dot north past the cairn.
facts.placement: runs from the center of carved_stone_slab north, passing just east of flame_cairn, toward distant_pale_spire, about 40 m long

facts.description: A flat round grey slab about 1 m wide, flush with the dust, ringed by about forty tally marks, the last few shallow and unfinished. Its central dot glows faintly warm.
facts.placement: at the base of flame_cairn, on its south side, about 1 m north of the wanderer

notes: Etched a thin silver-white seam of light from the slab's glowing dot, bending just east of the cairn and running north toward the spire. I also gave the slab forty tally marks and a warm glowing centre.

ops.name: light_seam
ops.doc: Thin glowing ribbon along a polyline on the ground. params: points [[x,z],...] relative, width (m), color

ops.name: tally_slab
ops.doc: Flat round stone slab with a ring of tally marks and glowing central dot. params: radius (m), color

thought: The light line points past the cairn toward the pale spire. Someone carved these marks and was interrupted; maybe the spire holds the answer.
action: follow the thin line of light north past the cairn toward the pale spire

narration: You rise and follow the silver seam past the cairn, its flame warming your shoulder as you go. The line runs true across the dust, humming faintly underfoot. Ahead, the pale spire sharpens, and at its base you glimpse a scatter of low, dark shapes, like stones, or people sitting very still.
movement: walks about 35 m north along slab_light_line, passing just east of flame_cairn, and stops about 5 m short of the spire's base region, with the spire roughly 40 m ahead

facts.description: Five hunched, hooded figures carved of dark grey stone, each about 1 m tall, sitting cross-legged in a loose ring, all facing the spire. Their hands are cupped in their laps as if holding something.
facts.placement: about 25 m north of the wanderer, around the base of distant_pale_spire, with slab_light_line passing through the ring's center

facts.description: A thin, pale, upright shaft of stone about 12 m tall, tapering to a point, faintly luminous against the dark horizon. It now appears to have a ring of seated figures at its foot.
facts.placement: about 40 m north of the wanderer

facts.description: Small silver studs, about 10 cm wide, set into the dust every 5 m along the glowing line, each pulsing softly in turn toward the spire.
facts.placement: along slab_light_line, between the wanderer and seated_stone_figures

notes: Raised a ring of five hooded stone figures around the spire's foot, with the silver seam extended through their center. Studded the line with softly pulsing silver marks and walked you north along it.

ops.name: seated_figures
ops.doc: Ring of hunched hooded seated stone figures facing center. params: count, radius (m), height (m), color

ops.name: hum_studs
ops.doc: Silver studs along the light seam, pulsing in sequence away from origin along -Z. params: count, spacing (m), color

thought: The spire is tall and pale, with small dark shapes at its base. I want to know whether they're stones or people.
action: walk along the silver line to the dark shapes at the spire's base and examine them

narration: You walk the humming line until the spire towers over you, a pale blade of stone ringed by five hooded figures. Each is carved from dark grey stone, knees crossed, cupped hands held out toward the spire's foot. In the center of the ring, the silver line ends at a small round hollow in the dust, and in each figure's palms sits a faint, empty dimple, as if something was once placed there.
movement: walks about 22 m north along slab_light_line and stops just outside the ring of seated_stone_figures, at the spire's foot

facts.description: A shallow round bowl about 0.6 m wide, sunk into the dust at the spire's foot, where the silver line ends. Its inner surface is smooth pale stone.
facts.placement: about 1 m south of distant_pale_spire's base, at the center of seated_stone_figures, at the end of slab_light_line

facts.description: Five hunched, hooded figures of dark grey stone, each about 1 m tall, cross-legged in a ring about 5 m across, facing the spire. Each holds cupped hands with a small round empty dimple in the palms.
facts.placement: ring around spire_base_hollow, directly ahead of the wanderer, about 4 m north

notes: Sank a smooth pale stone bowl at the spire's foot where the silver line ends, and tightened the five seated figures into a ring around it. Walked the Wanderer up to the ring's edge.

ops.name: stone_bowl
ops.doc: Shallow round bowl sunk in the ground with a pale rim. params: radius (m), depth (m), color

thought: The silver line ends at a hollow, and the figures' palms are empty. Something belongs here, and I'd like to know what the hollow wants.
action: kneel at the round hollow in the center and examine it closely

narration: You step between two of the seated figures and kneel at the bowl. Its inside is polished smooth and cold, and as you lean close, the silver line pulses once and a tiny sound answers from beneath, like a held breath. Deep in the pale stone you see a faint ring of five small notches, one for each figure. Behind you, the cairn's amber glow stretches your shadow across the dust.
movement: walks about 3 m north between two seated figures and kneels at the edge of spire_base_hollow

facts.description: Five small evenly spaced notches, each about 2 cm wide, cut into the inner rim of the bowl, each aimed at one of the seated figures.
facts.placement: inside spire_base_hollow, around its inner rim

facts.description: The silver studs now pulse faster as the Wanderer kneels, and the last one at the bowl glows brightest, as if the line is waiting.
facts.placement: along slab_light_line, ending at spire_base_hollow

notes: Cut five tiny notches around the bowl's rim, each aimed at a seated figure. The silver studs now pulse faster, and a new bright stud sits at the bowl where the line ends.

ops.name: rim_notches
ops.doc: Small evenly spaced dark notches around a bowl's inner rim, aimed at figures. params: radius (m), count, color

ops.name: hum_studs
ops.doc: Silver studs along the light seam, pulsing fast in sequence; final stud at the bowl glows brightest. params: count, spacing (m), color, endZ

thought: Five notches, five figures, five empty palms. Something is meant to be placed in them, and I should find out what the figures are holding out for.
action: examine the palms of the nearest hooded figure closely

narration: You turn to the nearest figure and crouch before its cupped hands. The stone is rough as cold slate, but the dimple in each palm is polished smooth, round, and no bigger than a plum. Etched in the bottom of this one is a tiny symbol: a crescent with a dot above it. Along the plain, one of the other figures' dimples catches a faint gleam, as if answering.

facts.description: A tiny crescent moon with a dot above it, etched in thin lines at the bottom of the palm dimple of the nearest figure. The lines are faintly pale against the dark stone.
facts.placement: inside the palm dimple of the seated figure nearest the wanderer, in seated_stone_figures, about 2 m northwest of the wanderer

facts.description: Five hunched, hooded figures of dark grey stone, each about 1 m tall, cross-legged in a ring about 5 m across, facing the spire. Each holds cupped hands with a smooth round dimple in the palms; each dimple is marked with a different symbol, and one on the far side of the ring glints faintly.
facts.placement: ring around spire_base_hollow, directly ahead of the wanderer, about 4 m north

notes: Pinned the nearest figure to the northwest and etched a pale crescent-and-dot into its palm dimple. I also added a faint glint in the palm of a figure on the far side of the ring.

ops.name: seated_figures
ops.doc: Ring of hunched hooded seated stone figures facing center. Figure 3 is pinned to the northwest. params: count, radius (m), height (m), color

ops.name: etched_symbol
ops.doc: Tiny flat etched symbol lying on a surface. params: kind ('crescent' or 'glint'), size (m), color

thought: Something gleamed from another figure, as if answering. I should go see what's different about it, and compare its symbol.
action: walk to the figure whose dimple gleams and examine its palm symbol

narration: You circle the ring, past the spire's pale flank, to the figure on the far side. Its dimple holds a small glint, and as you crouch you see a symbol etched in the bottom: a single open eye, wide and unblinking, with a line of rays beneath it like a sunrise. Where the crescent was quiet, this eye seems to watch you back, and the silver line gives one slow pulse.
movement: walks about 6 m around the ring, passing the spire's east side, and crouches before the far-side figure, south-west of the spire's base

facts.description: A tiny open eye with short rays fanning beneath it, etched in thin pale lines at the bottom of the palm dimple. A faint glint sits within it.
facts.placement: inside the palm dimple of the far-side figure in seated_stone_figures, about 5 m across the ring from the crescent figure, directly in front of the wanderer

notes: Etched a tiny open eye with fanning rays into the far-side figure's palm, beside its glint. I walked the Wanderer around the east side to crouch before it.

ops.name: etched_symbol
ops.doc: Tiny flat etched symbol on a surface. params: kind ('crescent','glint','eye'), size (m), color

thought: The eye watches me, and the glint in its palm might be something I can take. Five figures, five notches, so maybe I'm meant to gather five things.
action: reach into the palm's dimple and pick up the glinting object

narration: You slip two fingers into the dimple and lift out the glint: a smooth pearl of clear glass, no bigger than a plum stone, with a tiny flame of silver turning inside it. The moment it leaves the palm, the stone eye dims, and the silver line gives a long, low pulse toward the bowl. Across the ring, the crescent figure's dimple begins to glint in answer.

facts.description: A clear glass bead about 2 cm across with a tiny silver flame turning slowly inside it, glowing softly. Held in the Wanderer's hand.
facts.placement: in the Wanderer's right hand, at the far-side figure of seated_stone_figures

facts.description: The eye symbol is now dim and still, its glint gone since the pearl was taken.
facts.placement: inside the palm dimple of the far-side figure, directly in front of the wanderer

facts.description: A small new glint of pale light has appeared in the palm dimple of the crescent figure, like another pearl forming.
facts.placement: inside the palm dimple of the crescent figure, about 5 m across the ring from the wanderer

notes: Lifted the glass pearl into the Wanderer's hand, dimmed the eye symbol, and kindled a new glint in the crescent figure's palm.

ops.name: glass_pearl
ops.doc: Clear glass bead with a turning silver flame inside. params: size (m), color

thought: I have the glass pearl, and the crescent figure's dimple is glinting now. Maybe each figure holds a piece for the bowl.
action: walk to the crescent figure and examine its glinting dimple

narration: You cross the ring, the spire's pale flank sliding past, and kneel before the crescent figure. In its dimple a second pearl has formed, resting in the stone like a drop of dew, a tiny silver flame turning inside it. As you reach out, the five notches in the bowl behind you click softly, one of them lighting with a thin silver glow.
movement: walks about 5 m across the ring and kneels before the crescent figure

facts.description: A second glass pearl, clear with a tiny turning silver flame, now rests fully formed in the crescent figure's palm dimple, glowing softly.
facts.placement: inside the palm dimple of the crescent figure, about 0.5 m in front of the wanderer

facts.description: One of the five notches in the bowl rim now glows with a thin silver light, the notch aimed at the crescent figure.
facts.placement: on the inner rim of spire_base_hollow, about 5 m from the wanderer

notes: Set a second glowing pearl in the crescent figure's palm and lit the bowl notch that points toward it. The Wanderer now kneels in front of that figure.

thought: A second pearl has formed, and a notch lit up. Perhaps each pearl belongs in the bowl, so I'll take this one too.
action: take the second pearl from the crescent figure's dimple

narration: You lift the second pearl from the crescent figure's palm. It is cool and weightless, its silver flame turning against the first in your other hand. The lit notch in the bowl flares, then the whole ring of stone figures seems to lean closer. At the spire's foot, a thin seam opens in the pale stone, no wider than a hand, breathing a faint silver mist across the dust.

facts.description: A clear glass bead about 2 cm across with a tiny silver flame turning inside it, identical to the first pearl. Held in the Wanderer's left hand.
facts.placement: in the Wanderer's left hand, at the crescent figure

facts.description: The crescent figure's palm dimple is now empty and dull, its pearl taken.
facts.placement: inside the palm dimple of the crescent figure, about 0.5 m in front of the wanderer

facts.description: A narrow vertical seam about 1.5 m tall and 10 cm wide, split in the spire's pale stone, leaking a faint drifting silver mist that pools low over the dust.
facts.placement: in the south face of distant_pale_spire, just above spire_base_hollow, about 5 m from the wanderer

notes: Added the second pearl in the Wanderer's left hand and split a glowing, misting seam in the spire's south face. The crescent palm is now dull and empty.

ops.name: mist_seam
ops.doc: Narrow vertical glowing crack with drifting silver mist pooling low. params: height (m), width (m), color

thought: Two pearls, five notches, and now a seam breathing silver mist at the spire's foot. I should see what the seam holds.
action: kneel at the seam in the spire's foot and peer into the silver mist

narration: You kneel before the seam and the silver mist curls over your knees, cold and sweet like rain on stone. Inside, the spire is hollow: a narrow stair of pale steps spirals downward, each edge outlined in thin light. Far below, something rings once, a clear low note, and the mist flows toward you as if the spire were exhaling. Two pearls turn warm in your hands.
movement: kneels at the seam in the spire's south face, about 1 m from it

facts.description: A narrow spiral stair of pale stone steps, each about 1 m wide, edged with thin silver light, descending in a tight curve into the ground inside the hollow spire.
facts.placement: just inside spire_seam, descending below the base of distant_pale_spire

facts.description: The seam is now widened enough to show the stair within, still breathing silver mist that rolls low over the dust toward the Wanderer.
facts.placement: in the south face of distant_pale_spire, about 1 m in front of the kneeling wanderer

notes: Cut a round shaft into the plain at the spire's foot and wound a spiral stair of pale steps, edged in silver light, down into it. I knelt the Wanderer just south of the seam.

ops.name: dust_plain
ops.doc: Flat disc of pale dusty ground with faint ripples. params: radius (m), color, hole [x,z,r] optional circular opening

ops.name: spiral_stair
ops.doc: Spiral stair of pale steps with silver-lit edges descending into a shaft. params: steps, depth (m), radius (m), color

thought: The spire breathes and a stair spirals down. The pearls are warm, so maybe they're keys for whatever rang below. I want to know what made that note.
action: Step through the seam and descend the spiral stair, following the thin light down toward the ringing note.

narration: You slip through the seam and the spire closes its pale walls around you. The stair winds down in a tight curl, each step edged in silver, the mist pooling around your ankles. The ringing note grows clearer with every turn, and the pearls in your hands pulse in time with it. After a long descent the walls fall away, and you stand on a landing before a round chamber lit by a ring of five empty sockets.
movement: walks down spire_stair about 12 m in a spiral, ending on a round stone landing at the bottom, below the spire

facts.description: A round chamber about 8 m wide with a domed ceiling of smooth pale stone, softly lit by silver light. The floor is polished grey stone, still and cool.
facts.placement: about 12 m below the surface, directly beneath distant_pale_spire, at the foot of spire_stair

facts.description: Five round sockets about 3 cm wide, set in a ring in a waist-high stone pedestal and glowing faintly silver. Each is rimmed with a tiny symbol matching one of the seated figures.
facts.placement: in the center of lower_chamber, about 4 m north of the wanderer

facts.description: A small bell of dull silver, about 0.5 m tall, hanging from a thin chain in the dome above the pedestal. It sways slightly, though no wind is felt.
facts.placement: hanging from the ceiling of lower_chamber, about 4 m north of the wanderer, above pearl_sockets

notes: Deepened the stair to 12 m and built a round pale-stone domed chamber at its foot. In its centre is a pedestal with five glowing sockets and a silver bell swaying above it.

ops.name: round_chamber
ops.doc: Round domed chamber of pale stone with polished floor and silver light. params: radius (m), wallHeight (m), color

ops.name: socket_pedestal
ops.doc: Waist-high stone pedestal with a ring of glowing pearl sockets and tiny symbols. params: height (m), radius (m), sockets

ops.name: hanging_bell
ops.doc: Small dull silver bell on a thin chain; origin at the hanging point. params: chain (m), size (m)

thought: The chamber below is round and dim, with a white ring on its floor. I have two pearls, and five sockets wait for them.
action: step into the round chamber and examine the ring of five empty sockets

narration: You step onto the polished floor and the cool silver light settles on your hands. At the pedestal, the five sockets glow in a ring, each rimmed with a tiny symbol: a crescent, an open eye, and three you haven't yet met. Above, the small bell sways and rings once, and the two pearls tug in your palms like magnets toward their matching sockets.
movement: walks about 4 m north across lower_chamber and stops at the pedestal

facts.description: Five glowing sockets in the pedestal's top. Two are rimmed with a crescent and an open eye; the other three bear a wave, a tree and a key-like spiral, all faintly lit.
facts.placement: top of the pedestal in the center of lower_chamber, about 0.5 m in front of the wanderer

facts.description: A band of shallow carved pictures about 1 m tall circling the chamber wall, showing five hooded figures walking toward a pale spire. The last panel is blank, smooth stone.
facts.placement: around the wall of lower_chamber at eye level, 4 m from the pedestal

notes: Gave each of the five sockets its own glowing symbol (crescent, eye, wave, tree, spiral), and carved a band of five hooded walkers heading for a spire around the chamber wall, ending in a blank panel. The Wanderer stops just south of the pedestal.

ops.name: socket_pedestal
ops.doc: Waist-high stone pedestal with five glowing pearl sockets, each with a distinct symbol (crescent, eye, wave, tree, spiral). params: height, radius, sockets

ops.name: wall_carving_band
ops.doc: Band of shallow relief carvings on a round chamber wall: five hooded figures walking toward a spire, then a blank panel. params: radius (m), y (band center), height (m)

thought: The pearls are pulling toward their sockets. I'll place them where they belong, crescent and eye, and see what the chamber does.
action: place the crescent pearl in the crescent socket and the eye pearl in the eye socket

narration: You press the crescent pearl into its socket, then the eye pearl into the next. Each settles with a soft click, and the silver flames inside flare and pour into the stone as thin lines of light. Overhead the bell rings a long, clear note, and the wave, tree and spiral sockets brighten, hungry. In the blank last panel of the wall, a faint carving begins to scratch itself into being: a lone hooded figure, kneeling.

facts.description: The crescent and eye sockets now hold clear glass pearls, their silver flames drained into thin glowing lines that run across the pedestal top toward the wave, tree and spiral sockets, which glow brighter and remain empty.
facts.placement: top of the pedestal in the center of lower_chamber, about 0.5 m in front of the wanderer

facts.description: The first pearl now rests seated in the eye socket of the pedestal, no longer in the Wanderer's hand.
facts.placement: in the eye socket of pearl_sockets

facts.description: The second pearl now rests seated in the crescent socket of the pedestal, no longer in the Wanderer's hand.
facts.placement: in the crescent socket of pearl_sockets

facts.description: A newly scratched carving of a single hooded figure kneeling, about 1 m tall, pale lines glowing faintly silver, appearing in the previously blank final panel.
facts.placement: on chamber_wall_carvings, in the last blank panel, about 4 m northeast of the pedestal

notes: Seated both pearls in their sockets, ran thin silver lines across the pedestal top toward the empty sockets, and scratched a faintly glowing kneeling hooded figure into the last wall panel.

ops.name: kneeling_carving
ops.doc: Glowing silver relief of a kneeling hooded figure on a round chamber wall. params: radius (m), angle (rad, 0=south, sin->x), y (m), height (m)

thought: The kneeling figure carving looks like me. Three sockets are still hungry, so I want to see what the carving shows.
action: examine the carving of the kneeling hooded figure on the wall closely

narration: You cross the polished floor to the last panel and crouch before the kneeling figure. Its pale lines glow faintly, and you see it kneels before a small round hollow, hands cupped, just as you knelt at the bowl. Beside its knee, a new line of tiny scratches begins: a wave, a tree, a spiral, each drawn on a path leading away from the spire. Overhead the bell sways, and the carved figure's hood seems, for a moment, to turn toward you.
movement: walks about 4 m northeast across the chamber floor and crouches before the last wall panel

facts.description: Three thin glowing silver scratched pictures, each about 20 cm tall: a wave, a tree and a spiral. Each sits at the end of its own short line leading away from the kneeling figure, like three diverging roads.
facts.placement: on chamber_wall_carvings, beside the knee of kneeling_figure_carving, about 4 m northeast of the pedestal

facts.description: The kneeling hooded figure, about 1 m tall, kneels before a small round hollow with cupped hands, pale silver lines glowing. Its hood is tilted slightly toward the viewer.
facts.placement: on chamber_wall_carvings, last panel, about 1 m in front of the wanderer

notes: Scratched three thin silver roads fanning out from the kneeling figure's knee, ending in a wave, a tree and a spiral. I moved the Wanderer to crouch before the panel.

ops.name: scratch_trio
ops.doc: Three tiny glowing scratched pictures (wave, tree, spiral) at the ends of diverging lines on a round chamber wall. params: radius (m), angle (rad, 0=south, sin->x), y (m, base height)

thought: The carving shows three paths leading away from the spire: wave, tree, spiral. Those pearls must be out there, so I should climb back up and set out.
action: Climb the spiral stair back up and leave the spire to follow the path marked with the wave.

narration: You climb the spiral stair, the silver edging the steps like a rail of light, and slip out through the seam into the open dark. The ring of stone figures seems to have turned a little, all five now facing east. There, a new line of silver runs from the bowl across the dust, and at its end you hear faint water, like slow breathing. You follow it, and a low wall of pale mist waits ahead.
movement: climbs the stair to the surface, then walks about 25 m east along wave_silver_line and stops at the edge of a mist bank

facts.description: A thin glowing silver line, about 3 cm wide, etched in the dust, ending in a small wave-shaped mark at its start by the bowl. It leads east across the plain.
facts.placement: runs from spire_base_hollow about 40 m east, passing the wanderer's new position

facts.description: A low wall of pale silver mist about 3 m tall and 20 m wide, drifting slowly, with a faint blue shimmer inside as of water beyond.
facts.placement: about 3 m east of the wanderer, across wave_silver_line

facts.description: The five hooded stone figures have turned in place to face east, their empty cupped hands pointing along wave_silver_line.
facts.placement: ring around spire_base_hollow, about 25 m west of the wanderer

notes: Etched a silver wave-line east from the bowl, turned the five stone figures to face east, and raised a drifting blue-shimmering mist bank across the line. The Wanderer now stands on the surface at the mist's edge.

ops.name: seated_figures
ops.doc: Ring of hunched hooded seated stone figures facing center, or all facing east if faceEast. Figure 3 pinned to the northwest. params: count, radius (m), height (m), color, faceEast

ops.name: mist_bank
ops.doc: Low drifting wall of pale silver mist with faint blue shimmer inside. Width runs along local X. params: width (m), height (m), color

thought: A wall of pale mist blocks the way, with a faint shimmering water-like band behind it. The silver line runs straight into it, so I'll follow it.
action: Follow the silver line into the pale mist toward the sound of water.

narration: You step into the mist and it closes cold and damp around you, beading on your hood. The silver line glows underfoot, steady as a heartbeat. After about twenty paces the white thins and you step out onto a shore of dark wet sand. A black, glassy lake lies ahead, utterly still, and the silver line runs straight into it, shining beneath the surface.
movement: walks about 25 m east along wave_silver_line, through east_mist_bank, and stops at the edge of a lake shore

facts.description: A wide, perfectly still lake of black glassy water that reflects the stars like a second sky. It stretches far beyond sight.
facts.placement: begins about 25 m east of the wanderer's former position, just beyond east_mist_bank, extending east to the horizon

facts.description: A narrow strip of dark, damp sand about 4 m wide, studded with tiny pale shells, running north to south along the lake's edge.
facts.placement: between east_mist_bank and mirror_lake, directly under the wanderer

facts.description: The silver line continues straight into the lake, glowing beneath the black water as a submerged ribbon of light heading east.
facts.placement: runs from the shore under the wanderer's feet into mirror_lake, about 30 m east

notes: Laid a strip of dark shell-flecked sand, then a vast black mirror lake with reflected stars beyond it. The silver line now runs on beneath the water for 30 m.

ops.name: mirror_water
ops.doc: Large still black glassy water plane with reflected star specks. params: width (m, X), depth (m, Z), color

ops.name: wet_shore
ops.doc: Strip of dark damp sand with tiny pale shells. params: width (m, X), length (m, Z), shells

thought: The silver line runs under the black water. I'll kneel at the edge and look into the lake before stepping in.
action: kneel at the water's edge and look down at the silver line beneath the surface

narration: You kneel on the damp sand and lean over the water. Beneath your reflected hood the silver line glows, a ribbon of light sinking slowly away from shore. Ten paces out, something pale rests on the line: a small boat's shape, drifting not at all. As you watch, the line pulses once, and the boat's reflection ripples though the water stays still.
movement: kneels at the water's edge on dark_wet_shore, staying in place

facts.description: A small narrow rowing boat about 3 m long, built of pale bleached wood with a upswept prow, floating motionless on the black water directly above the silver line. A single short oar lies across its seats.
facts.placement: about 10 m east of the wanderer, on mirror_lake, centered over wave_silver_line

facts.description: A short weathered grey post about 1 m tall, leaning slightly, with a loop of frayed pale rope trailing toward the water.
facts.placement: on dark_wet_shore, about 2 m south of the wanderer

notes: Set a pale bleached skiff afloat over the silver line ten paces east, and leaned a frayed-rope mooring post in the wet sand just south of the kneeling Wanderer.

ops.name: pale_skiff
ops.doc: Small narrow rowing boat, length along local X, upswept prow at +X, oar across seats. params: length (m), color

ops.name: mooring_post
ops.doc: Short weathered leaning post with a frayed pale rope loop trailing toward +X. params: height (m), color

thought: The boat sits right on the silver line, and there's a post beside me at the shore. Maybe the boat can be drawn in.
action: examine the dark post beside me, then tug the boat toward shore along the silver line

narration: You touch the post: grey wood, cold and salt-rough, with a groove worn where the rope once bit. Tied to its loop, the frayed rope trails into the water, and when you pull, the line goes taut. The skiff slides toward you over the silver ribbon, silent, leaving no ripples. It bumps the sand at your feet, and on its seat a small third pearl glints beside the oar, etched with a wave.

facts.description: The skiff now rests with its prow on the sand, pulled in along the silver line by the rope, still silent and unrippling. A single oar lies across its seats.
facts.placement: at the water's edge on dark_wet_shore, about 1 m east of the wanderer

facts.description: A clear glass pearl, plum-stone sized, with a silver flame turning inside and a tiny wave etched on its surface.
facts.placement: on the middle seat of pale_skiff, beside the oar

facts.description: The post is cold grey wood with a worn groove at the loop. The frayed rope is now taut, running from it to the skiff's prow.
facts.placement: on dark_wet_shore, about 2 m south of the wanderer, rope reaching pale_skiff

notes: Pulled the skiff up onto the sand along the silver line, prow toward shore, with a taut rope to the post. Set a wave-etched pearl glinting on the middle seat beside the oar.

thought: The skiff is here with a third pearl, wave-etched. I'll take it before doing anything else.
action: pick up the wave pearl from the skiff's seat and examine it closely

narration: You lift the wave pearl from the seat. It is cool and weightless, a tiny wave etched on its glass, the silver flame inside rolling slowly like a tide. As you turn it, the flame stills, and a faint line of light stretches from the pearl out over the lake, pointing east past the skiff's prow. Far out on the black water, a single pinprick of green light blinks once, then again.

facts.description: The clear glass pearl, plum-stone sized, now rests in the Wanderer's palm. A tiny wave is etched on it, and its silver flame rolls slowly like a tide, then stills and casts a thin beam east.
facts.placement: in the Wanderer's hand, about 0.5 m in front of the wanderer

facts.description: A thin silver beam of light, about 2 cm wide, running from the pearl low over the water toward the far green light, faintly shimmering.
facts.placement: from the wanderer's hand east over mirror_lake, about 30 m long, ending at far_green_light

facts.description: A small steady green lantern-like light, blinking slowly, floating just above the water. It marks something unseen far out on the lake.
facts.placement: about 45 m east of the wanderer, over mirror_lake

notes: Lifted the wave pearl into the Wanderer's palm, and it now casts a thin silver beam east across the lake. Far out, a small green light blinks above the black water.

ops.name: green_beacon
ops.doc: Small blinking green lantern light floating above water, no real light. params: size (m), color

thought: The skiff is ready and the green light blinks far out east. The wave pearl points the way, so I'll row toward it.
action: Climb into the skiff, take the oar, and row east along the pearl's line toward the green light.

narration: You step into the skiff and it dips not at all, as if the water were glass. Seated, you take the oar and push off the sand. The boat glides east along the silver ribbon beneath you, the pearl's beam steady ahead. Stars lie on the water on every side, and the green light grows from a pinprick to a small lantern hanging on a slender post, rising from the lake.
movement: rows about 30 m east over mirror_lake along wave_silver_line and stops about 12 m short of the green light

facts.description: A slender black post about 2 m tall rising straight from the water, topped by a small iron cage holding the green flame. Its base makes no ripples.
facts.placement: about 12 m east of the wanderer in the skiff, directly under far_green_light

facts.description: The skiff now floats on the lake with the Wanderer seated in it, gliding silently east along the silver line, the oar dipping without ripples.
facts.placement: on mirror_lake, about 30 m east of dark_wet_shore, at the wanderer's position

facts.description: The green light is now clearly a lantern flame in a small cage atop lantern_post, blinking slowly.
facts.placement: about 12 m east of the wanderer, atop lantern_post

notes: Raised a slender black lantern post from the water with a small iron cage around the green flame. Rowed the skiff 30 m east and turned its prow that way.

ops.name: lantern_post
ops.doc: Slender black post topped by a small iron cage. params: height (m), color

thought: The green lantern glows ahead on its slender post, and the silver line leads straight to it. I want to see what it holds.
action: Row on east until the skiff drifts alongside the post, then examine the green lantern closely.

narration: You dip the oar and the skiff slides alongside the black post, stopping without a bump. The lantern's cage is iron, thin-barred and leaf-patterned, and the green flame inside blinks slowly, like an eye. Beneath it, scratched into the post at your eye level, is a tiny tree. As you lean close, the flame leans toward you, and the pearl in your palm warms.
movement: rows about 12 m east along the silver line and drifts to a stop alongside lantern_post

facts.description: The skiff rests motionless against the lantern post, its oar shipped across the seat.
facts.placement: on mirror_lake, alongside lantern_post, about 0.5 m west of it

facts.description: A small tree with bare branches, about 15 cm tall, scratched into the black wood and faintly glowing green.
facts.placement: on lantern_post, about 1.5 m above the water, facing the skiff

facts.description: The green flame sits in an iron cage with leaf-shaped bars, and leans toward the Wanderer when approached.
facts.placement: atop lantern_post, about 1 m east of the wanderer, 2 m above the water

notes: Drew the skiff alongside the black post and scratched a faintly glowing little tree into the wood, facing the boat. The beam shrinks to a short thread to the lantern.

ops.name: scratched_tree
ops.doc: Tiny glowing scratched bare tree, faces local -Z (double sided). params: height (m), color

thought: The flame leans toward me and the pearl is warm. The tree mark must match the tree socket, so maybe the lantern holds the next pearl.
action: Hold the warm wave pearl up to the green flame and gently open the lantern's cage.

narration: You raise the wave pearl to the cage and the green flame presses against the bars, trembling. The leaf-shaped door swings open at your touch without a sound. The flame drifts into the pearl's glass and swirls there, green threaded through silver. The lantern goes dark, and beneath the skiff the silver line brightens and bends south, away from the post.

facts.description: The green flame has left its cage and now swirls inside the wave pearl. The iron cage is dark, its leaf-shaped door hanging open.
facts.placement: atop lantern_post, 2 m above the water, about 1 m east of the wanderer

facts.description: The pearl now holds a swirl of green flame woven through its silver, glowing teal and warm in the Wanderer's palm.
facts.placement: in the Wanderer's hand, about 0.5 m in front of the wanderer

facts.description: A new silver ribbon of light, about 5 cm wide, glowing beneath the black water and bending away from the old line toward the south.
facts.placement: branches from wave_silver_line at the skiff, runs about 30 m south across mirror_lake

notes: The green flame now swirls inside the pearl, and the lantern cage is dark. I laid a silver ribbon bending south from the skiff across the lake.

ops.name: glass_pearl
ops.doc: Clear glass bead with a turning flame inside. params: size (m), color, flame (flame color)

ops.name: green_beacon
ops.doc: Small blinking green lantern light floating above water; params: size, color, dark (1 = extinguished)

thought: The lantern is dark and the silver line bends south. The pearl now holds green and silver, so I'll follow the line and see where it leads.
action: Row the skiff south, following the brightened silver line away from the dark post.

narration: You turn the skiff south and dip the oar. The silver ribbon glows beneath you, wider now, and the boat glides on without a ripple. Behind, the dark post shrinks to a thread. Ahead, a low island rises from the black water: a hump of pale rock, with a single bare tree upon it, its branches faintly green.
movement: rows about 30 m south along south_silver_branch and stops about 10 m short of the island's shore

facts.description: A low rounded island of pale grey rock about 14 m wide, rising 1 m above the water, with a thin pebbly beach on its north side.
facts.placement: about 10 m south of the wanderer in the skiff, at the end of south_silver_branch

facts.description: A leafless tree about 4 m tall with twisted silver-grey branches whose tips glow faintly green. Its trunk is thick and split at the base like a doorway.
facts.placement: center of tree_island

facts.description: The silver ribbon ends at the island's beach, its glow rising up the sand toward the tree's roots.
facts.placement: runs from the skiff's former spot south 30 m to tree_island

notes: Raised a pale rock islet with a pebbly north beach and a split-trunked bare tree with green-glowing twig tips. I extended the silver ribbon to the beach and moved the skiff 30 m south.

ops.name: rock_island
ops.doc: Low rounded pale rock island with pebbly beach on its north (-Z) side. params: radius (m), height (m), color

ops.name: glow_bare_tree
ops.doc: Leafless twisted silver-grey tree with a split doorway trunk and green glowing twig tips. params: height (m), color, glow

thought: The island glows pale and the tree's branches hold tiny lights, like stars caught in it. This must be the tree socket's place.
action: Row the skiff to the island's shore, step onto the pale rock, and examine the bare tree.

narration: You row the last few strokes and the skiff's prow grinds softly onto the pebbly beach. You step onto cold pale rock, black pebbles clicking underfoot, and climb to the tree. Its trunk is split at the base like a narrow doorway, and the green-tipped branches hum faintly. Inside the split, in the dark heartwood, something small and round glints.
movement: rows about 10 m south to the island's north beach, steps ashore, and walks about 6 m up the rock to stand before the split trunk of bare_glow_tree

facts.description: A small round glint of glass, about 5 cm wide, resting deep in the dark heartwood inside the split trunk, pulsing faintly green like a slow heartbeat.
facts.placement: inside the split at the base of bare_glow_tree, about 1 m in front of the wanderer

facts.description: The skiff is now beached on the pebbly north shore of the island, its prow on the stones, rope slack.
facts.placement: on the north beach of tree_island, about 6 m north of the wanderer

notes: Beached the skiff on the island's pebbly north shore and set the Wanderer before the split trunk. A small green-pulsing glass glint now sits in the dark heartwood of the doorway.

thought: The tree stands before me, its branches tipped with light. Something round glints in the split trunk, and I think it's the tree pearl.
action: Reach carefully into the split in the trunk and take the glinting round object.

narration: You slip your hand into the split trunk. The heartwood is warm, almost alive, and your fingers close on a small glass pearl. It comes free with a soft sound like a held breath. Etched on it is a tiny tree, and inside, a green flame turns slowly. The branches overhead flare brighter, then their glow runs down the trunk and into the rock, and the thin silver ribbon at the beach flickers toward the south.

facts.description: A cool weightless glass pearl about 5 cm wide, etched with a tiny bare tree, holding a slow-turning green flame threaded with silver.
facts.placement: in the Wanderer's cupped hand, about 0.5 m in front of the wanderer

facts.description: The glint is gone from the heartwood; the pearl has been taken.
facts.placement: inside the split at the base of bare_glow_tree

facts.description: The silver ribbon now flickers and runs on past the island's south edge, glowing under the black water toward a distant point south.
facts.placement: from tree_island's south shore, extending about 30 m south over mirror_lake

notes: Took the glint out of the heartwood and set a green-flamed tree pearl in the Wanderer's hand. The silver ribbon now flickers on south from the island's shore across the black water.

thought: I have the tree pearl now, and the silver ribbon flickers south. Three pearls turn in my hands, and two sockets remain, so I should follow the line.
action: Return to the skiff and row south along the flickering silver ribbon.

narration: You climb down the pebbly beach and step into the skiff, tree pearl cupped in your palm. You push off and the boat glides south over the silver ribbon, which flickers like a pulse. Behind you the bare tree dims to a faint green speck. Ahead, a low shape rises from the water: a spiral of pale stone, turning slowly like a whorl of shell.
movement: steps into pale_skiff and rows about 30 m south along south_silver_branch, stopping a few meters short of spiral_islet

facts.description: A low islet of pale stone about 10 m wide, its surface carved in a shallow spiral groove that winds to a center, edged with faint silver light.
facts.placement: about 34 m south of tree_island, at the end of south_silver_branch, about 4 m south of the wanderer

facts.description: The skiff glides on the black water carrying the Wanderer, silent and rippleless, its prow pointing south.
facts.placement: on mirror_lake, about 30 m south of tree_island, under the wanderer

facts.description: The tree pearl rests in the Wanderer's palm in the skiff, its green flame turning slowly.
facts.placement: in the Wanderer's cupped hand, about 0.5 m in front of the wanderer

notes: Raised a pale stone islet carved with a silver-edged spiral groove to the south, and carried the skiff and pearl down the ribbon to stop just short of it.

ops.name: spiral_islet
ops.doc: Low pale stone islet with a shallow spiral groove edged in silver light. params: radius (m), height (m), color

thought: A spiral of pale stone rises ahead, matching the last empty socket. The picture shows a spiral disc on the dark water, so I'll row to it.
action: Row the skiff to the spiral of pale stone, step onto it, and examine the spiral carving closely.

narration: You ease the skiff against the islet and step onto cool pale stone. The spiral groove winds inward under your boots, edged with silver light that pulses like slow breath. At its center is a round hollow, exactly the size of a pearl. You kneel, and the groove's light brightens, running toward your hands as though it recognizes what you carry.
movement: rows about 4 m south, steps out of the skiff onto spiral_islet and kneels at the center of the spiral

facts.description: A smooth round hollow about 6 cm wide at the center of the spiral groove, empty, its rim glowing faintly silver and sized for a pearl.
facts.placement: at the center of spiral_islet, directly in front of the kneeling wanderer

facts.description: The spiral groove's silver edging now pulses slowly and brightens toward the center, running toward the Wanderer's hands.
facts.placement: about 4 m south of the skiff, which is moored against its north edge

facts.description: The skiff rests against the north edge of spiral_islet, still and silent, empty now.
facts.placement: against the north shore of spiral_islet, about 4 m north of the wanderer

notes: Placed a small glowing pearl-sized hollow at the spiral's center and moved the Wanderer to kneel there. The skiff is snug against the islet's north shore.

ops.name: pearl_hollow
ops.doc: Small smooth round hollow with faintly glowing silver rim, flush to a surface. params: radius (m), color

thought: The spiral groove glows as if it knows my pearls. The hollow at the center is waiting for the spiral pearl, but I only hold wave and tree, so I'll see what the hollow wants.
action: Walk the spiral groove inward to the central hollow, kneel, and examine it closely, holding the wave and tree pearls near.

narration: You follow the groove inward, step by step, the silver edging pulsing in time with your pulse. At the center you kneel and bring the wave and tree pearls close. The hollow's rim brightens, and both pearls tremble, their green flames leaning toward it. Yet only one pearl-sized hollow waits, and the spiral pearl still lies somewhere unseen, for the groove's light now runs on, thin and bright, down into the water.
movement: walks about 4 m along the spiral groove to the center of spiral_islet and kneels at spiral_center_hollow

facts.description: A thin silver line, about 3 cm wide, leaves the spiral's center hollow and runs over the islet's edge, sinking into the black water and glowing downward like a stair of light.
facts.placement: from spiral_center_hollow south to the islet edge, about 3 m south of the wanderer, then down beneath mirror_lake

facts.description: The hollow's rim glows brighter silver, and the wave and tree pearls held near it tremble with their flames leaning toward it. It remains empty.
facts.placement: at the center of spiral_islet, directly in front of the kneeling wanderer

notes: Ran a thin silver line from the center hollow south over the islet's edge, then added glowing steps that descend beneath the black water. The hollow's rim now glows brighter.

ops.name: glow_steps
ops.doc: Stair of small glowing silver treads descending along local +Z. params: count, run (m), drop (m), width (m), color

thought: The groove's light runs off into the water; the spiral pearl must lie that way. I should follow it back to the skiff.
action: Return to the skiff and row along the thin bright light running from the spiral's groove into the water.

narration: You step back into the skiff and push off the spiral's edge. The bright line slides beneath the hull, running south, then dipping steeply downward. The boat follows it, and the water ahead begins to glow from below, a pale silver well opening in the black lake. Around its rim, the stars on the surface seem to spin slowly, like water draining into a deep drain.
movement: rows about 20 m south along spiral_descending_line and stops at the rim of the silver whirl

facts.description: A circular patch of lake about 6 m wide glowing pale silver from beneath, with the black water and reflected stars turning slowly around it like a drain. The surface stays smooth and the glowing steps of light descend inside it.
facts.placement: about 20 m south of spiral_islet, directly in front of the skiff, on mirror_lake

facts.description: The skiff floats at the rim of silver_whirl, its prow pointing south, silent and unrippling, with the Wanderer seated inside holding two pearls.
facts.placement: about 2 m north of silver_whirl's edge, on mirror_lake

notes: Opened a silver whirl in the lake with slowly turning star specks around its rim and glowing steps spiralling down inside. Moved the skiff and the Wanderer's two pearls up to its northern edge.

ops.name: silver_whirl
ops.doc: Circular glowing silver patch on water with slowly rotating rings and star specks, like a drain; spiral glowing steps inside. params: radius (m), color

thought: The water is opening into a silver well, and the line leads down. The spiral pearl must lie below. I'll trust the light and let the skiff follow it.
action: Hold both pearls close and let the skiff drift down into the silver well, following the bright line.

narration: The skiff tips into the silver well and does not fall so much as settle, turning slowly with the stars. Glowing steps spiral down beneath the hull, and the black water rises around you like walls of glass, closing overhead. The two pearls grow warm and hum together. Below, a wide pale floor of light waits, and on it, a single dark shape.
movement: The skiff descends about 15 m down the spiral of light inside silver_whirl and comes to rest just above a pale floor.

facts.description: A tall cylindrical shaft about 6 m wide, its walls of black water held apart like glass, with stars drifting slowly down their sides. Glowing spiral steps run along its floor.
facts.placement: around the skiff, from the lake surface down about 15 m, under silver_whirl

facts.description: A wide round floor of smooth pale stone about 12 m across, faintly glowing silver. The spiral steps of light end at its rim.
facts.placement: about 15 m below the surface of mirror_lake, directly under silver_whirl, about 2 m below the skiff

facts.description: A squat dark stone pedestal about 1 m tall, with a single round hollow in its top marked with a spiral. It stands alone and still.
facts.placement: center of lakebed_floor, about 4 m south of the skiff
